Author Annie Jacobsen joins Danny Jones to warn that the Pentagon plans for a doomsday plague. Jacobsen writes books based on deep talks with defense staff. Her work names the plans that sit in files most people never see.

Jacobsen explains how the defense world games out germ attacks and mass death. She walks through the labs, the war games, and the grim math in the plans. Jones asks how close such plans sit to real events. Listeners get a cold look at a dark corner of state planning. The library holds the talk as an archive record of her reporting and claims.
